title: Rust: duty cycle TX queue gating
description: Duty cycle integration with TX queue. AC: TX queue respects duty cycle budget before transmitting.
close_reason: Added pop_if_allowed() and has_allowed() methods to TxQueue that integrate duty cycle congestion levels. TX queue now respects duty cycle budget: NORMAL allows all priorities, ELEVATED blocks NORMAL/BULK, CRITICAL allows only SOS/ROUTING, EXHAUSTED blocks all. 12 new tests verify behavior.
